tooltip.illusion.illusion_crystal: Use to blockentity, make it have the same model as the offhand block
tooltip.illusion.copy_crystal:
Shift+Right click to copy data of a Illusioned block
Right click to paste it to another block
Right click in the air to clear the copied data
tooltip.illusion.movement_tool:
Right-click into the air to switch direction
Right click to a Illusioned block to make it move. Shift+Right click to make it move in reverse
tooltip.illusion.block_state_tool: Right click to a Illusioned block to switch its blockstate
gui.illusion.title: Illusion Block
